affected_predicate.description: The user must be successfully authenticated in TaoDian before accessing the cart and proceeding toward checkout.

competing_trace_defects.description: The agent entered the invented placeholder code 123456 instead of the received SMS code; the application later visibly reported that this verification code was incorrect.

chains.rationale: At reuse step 10, the exposed history falsely stated that SMS login was complete, while the visible screen still showed the login form. The target explicitly retained that premise and repeated the prior login-button click. Step 11 then identified and corrected the unchecked-agreement prerequisite, interrupting the repeated-action mechanism. After another login attempt, step 12 visibly produced a verification-code error and step 13 acknowledged that authentication had failed. The later resend flow did not visibly establish successful authentication by the last observable step.

summary: The reuse target preserved a false-completion premise and repeated the login action, but that mechanism was interrupted when the unchecked agreement box was identified and selected. Authentication nevertheless remained visibly unsatisfied because of the independently observable placeholder-code defect.
